pairs: Dicebat autem et parabolam ad illos,
Now he also told them a parable,
quoniam oportet semper orare et non deficere,
that we should continually pray and not cease,
Judex quidam erat in quadam civitate,
“There was a certain judge in a certain city,
Vidua autem quædam erat in civitate illa,
But there was a certain widow in that city,
And he refused to do so for a long time.
Post hæc autem dixit intra se:
But afterwards, he said within himself:
Etsi Deum non timeo, nec hominem revereor:
‘Even though I do not fear God, nor respect man,
tamen quia molesta est mihi hæc vidua,
yet because this widow is pestering me, I will vindicate her,
ne in novissimo veniens sugillet me.
she may, in the end, wear me out.’”
“Listen to what the unjust judge said.
Deus autem non faciet vindictam electorum suorum clamantium ad se die ac nocte,
So then, will not God grant the vindication of his elect, who cry out to him day and night?
Or will he continue to endure them?
Dico vobis quia cito faciet vindictam illorum.
I tell you that he will quickly bring vindication to them.
when the Son of man returns,
do you think that he will find faith on earth?”
Dixit autem et ad quosdam qui in se confidebant tamquam justi,
Now about certain persons who consider themselves to be just,
Duo homines ascenderunt in templum ut orarent:
“Two men ascended to the temple, in order to pray.
One was a Pharisee, and the other was a tax collector.
Pharisæus stans, hæc apud se orabat:
Standing, the Pharisee prayed within himself in this way:
gratias ago tibi, quia non sum sicut ceteri hominum:
I give thanks to you that I am not like the rest of men:
even as this tax collector chooses to be.
I give tithes from all that I possess.’
And the tax collector, standing at a distance,
nolebat nec oculos ad cælum levare: sed percutiebat pectus suum,
was not willing to even lift up his eyes to heaven. But he struck his chest,
‘O God, be merciful to me, a sinner.’
descendit hic justificatus in domum suam ab illo:
this one descended to his house justified, but not the other.
quia omnis qui se exaltat, humiliabitur,
For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled;
and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.”
Afferebant autem ad illum et infantes,
And they were bringing little children to him,
so that he might touch them.
And when the disciples saw this,
“Allow the children to come to me,
and do not be an obstacle to them.
For of such is the kingdom of God.
quicumque non acceperit regnum Dei sicut puer,
whoever will not accept the kingdom of God like a child,
And a certain leader questioned him,
what should I do to possess eternal life?”
No one is good except God alone.
You shall not give false testimony.
Hæc omnia custodivi a juventute mea.
“I have kept all these things from my youth.”
“One thing is still lacking for you.
Sell all the things that you have,
And then you will have treasure in heaven.
Videns autem Jesus illum tristem factum,
Then Jesus, seeing him brought to sorrow,
Quam difficile, qui pecunias habent, in regnum Dei intrabunt!
“How difficult it is for those who have money to enter into the kingdom of God!
facilius est enim camelum per foramen acus transire quam divitem intrare in regnum Dei.
For it is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle, than for a wealthy man to enter into the kingdom of God.”
And those who were listening to this said,
“Then who is able to be saved?”
Quæ impossibilia sunt apud homines, possibilia sunt apud Deum.
“Things that are impossible with men are possible with God.”
Ecce nos dimisimus omnia et secuti sumus te.
we have left everything, and we have followed you.”
nemo est qui reliquit domum, aut parentes,
there is no one who has left behind home, or parents,
for the sake of the kingdom of God,
et non recipiat multo plura in hoc tempore,
who will not receive much more in this time,
et in sæculo venturo vitam æternam.
and in the age to come eternal life.”
Then Jesus took the twelve aside,
et consummabuntur omnia quæ scripta sunt per prophetas de Filio hominis:
and everything shall be completed which was written by the prophets about the Son of man.
For he will be handed over to the Gentiles,
And after they have scourged him,
And on the third day, he will rise again.”
But they understood none of these things.
et erat verbum istud absconditum ab eis,
For this word was concealed from them,
and they did not understand the things that were said.
a certain blind man was sitting beside the way,
And when he heard the multitude passing by,
Dixerunt autem ei quod Jesus Nazarenus transiret.
And they told him that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by.
Et qui præibant, increpabant eum ut taceret.
And those who were passing by rebuked him, so that he would be silent.
Yet truly, he cried out all the more,
Stans autem Jesus jussit illum adduci ad se.
Then Jesus, standing still, ordered him to be brought to him.
And when he had drawn near,
Quid tibi vis faciam? At ille dixit:
“What do you want, that I might do for you?”
And he followed him, magnifying God.
